_doc: HB1c sandbag look (src/sandbags.cpp). tint: multiplies the bag texture (linear rgb) - the user's model is a strong red-brown, this takes it to a duller hessian tan-brown. valueVar / hueVar: per-bag brightness and warm-cool spread. dirt / dirtHeight: bags whose centre is low in their piece darken toward this factor at the ground. lengthFill / fullness / bed: how far a bag overlaps its neighbours end to end, how much plumper than its box, how deep (m) it sits into the course below. jitter: scales every per-bag irregularity (size, yaw, tilt, in / out, level); 0 = tidy rows. sagShare: share of bags slumped at a steeper tilt.
